results.title: Pasalubong
results.overview: A nine-year-old boy, Kido, goes to meet his older sister at a protest camp fighting against the land grabbing of farmlands in Nueva Ecija—bringing her a frog and a squash as his simple gifts.

results.title: Secret of Admiral Ushakov
results.overview: Russian Empire, 1812. While Napoleon gathers his troops, a French spy infiltrates Admiral Fyodor Ushakov's estate. The great naval commander is ready to rejoin the fray, and his weapons will be his faith and love for his homeland.

results.title: Тазы
results.overview: Together with his like-minded associates, Rashid is striving to secure recognition for the Tazy as a distinct dog breed, as well as its recognition at the international level. After all, officially there exists only the category of "Central Asian Sighthound," which encompasses a multitude of varieties—including the Tazy. For Rashid, the Tazy is not merely a variety, but a unique cultural phenomenon that demands careful preservation.

results.title: My Brother's Killer
results.overview: The unsolved murder of Billy London, a gay adult film performer brutally killed in West Hollywood, was an urban legend for 33 years. A documentary intended to honor his life took an unexpected turn when members of the community joined forces to uncover overlooked clues, and seek a resolution to the mystery of who killed him. Drawing on a rare trove of VHS and personal footage, the film reveals a chilling overlap between the victim and some of the suspects who were captured on camera in films made in the narrow window of Billy's death.

results.title: The Mother and the Bear
results.overview: When her daughter falls into a temporary coma after an accident at her home in Winnipeg, Sara, an overbearing Korean mother travels from Seoul to Canada and vows to keep her daughter safe forever by catfishing a husband for her online.

results.title: Fear Lake Lanier
results.overview: Jimeia, a determined young woman who is trying to confront her past trauma, returns to the same lake where she lost her best friend and fiance on the same night. As she arrives, she is engulfed in eerie memories and unsettling legends surrounding the lake, known for its haunting tales of lost souls and inexplicable disappearances.

results.title: Showtime Baby
results.overview: A dysfunctional band loses their frontman 10 minutes before showtime, leaving a teenager to navigating egos, hard drugs and a little death to wrangle them back together. A loud and fast fever dream that interrogates our assumptions on identity and awakens the inner child in us all.

results.title: Falling into Place
results.overview: Kaia returns home for her town's fall festival as well as her high school reunion and spends the week with her childhood best friend, James, to complete their unfinished fall bucket list.

results.title: The Devil's Valley
results.overview: In this week's show: Sinos River Valley, Southern Brazil, 19th century. An unholy name spreads across the German settlements, preceded by terror and followed by tragedy... Who was the “Devil Kid”? Find out the facts on Fabão's Sunday Show!

results.title: He Loves Me Not
results.overview: An aspiring actress chosen as a wild card for a reality TV dating show uses a secret elixir to win the heart of the star, but when her deception is revealed, she discovers a messy but real chance for love.

results.title: Obsess
results.overview: Lucy Bel, a literary icon and woman of power, sees her empire threatened by an admirer whose fascination turns into obsession. When admiration is no longer enough, becoming her becomes a necessity. How far must one go to stay on top?

results.title: Ordoobehesht
results.overview: Shah Mehdi, a man who is not in a good financial situation and his wife has left home due to debts he has accumulated. In such a situation, his daughter, along with 6 other girls, drown in the city park during a camp they have attended on behalf of the school. Despite all his bad financial situation and the various tempting offers that are given to him and his family after this incident, Shah Mehdi seeks to avenge his daughter's blood.

results.title: Así no juega Perú
results.overview: Three older sex workers try to rebuild their lives in a conservative town after being displaced by a younger generation.

results.title: Dinogeist
results.overview: A greedy developer disturbs sacred land, unleashing ghostly dinosaurs that terrorize a neighborhood as residents face a prehistoric curse.

results.title: One Woman One Bra
results.overview: In a rural village, an orphaned girl named Star races against time to prove her family lineage and claim her land deed, facing obstacles from hostile neighbors and shady organizations while unexpectedly finding romance along the way.

results.title: Faust
results.overview: After making a deal with the devil, an isolated and unsatisfied professor uses supernatural means to achieve success and happiness at the cost of his soul.

results.title: Mission D.D.L.J.
results.overview: Diya dreams of a fairy tale love story like Dilwale Dulhaniya Le Jayenge & Dhrubo doesn’t belive in classic love. Eventually life brings them to a point, where they both have to come together & follow the paths.

results.title: I Didn't Like You
results.overview: As Emilia and Maxine spy on their best friend's first date, they come to realize the chemistry might not be between the couple they anticipated.

results.title: Sugar
results.overview: Gay besties Jayke and Matty's friendship is put to the test when an anonymous sugar daddy offers them exorbitant sums for custom fetish videos. SUGAR offers a thought provoking cautionary tale packaged in a queer dark comedy thriller.
